result: Browser modifier shortcuts no longer change image zoom or gallery position; Escape dismisses the action menu before the viewer and returns focus to its trigger. Three related suites passed 44 tests; lint and TypeScript passed.
touch_follow_up: Commit 191b3d33 fixes pointer ownership, pinch-to-pan transitions and cancellation. Three related suites passed 46 tests; lint and TypeScript passed. These are simulated pointer events.
limitations: Real touch gestures, browser zoom, viewport matrix and two-client permission changes remain unverified.
